search.website_text:
# Snowcloak Sync
The snow may cloak the world in silence, but come in, warm up, and reveal your true colours.

A Dalamud plugin.

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1408265972720078990?color=5865F2&label=discord&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/elznmods)

## Usage and Installation

For details on how to use Snowcloak, including install instructions, give our [docs](https://docs.snowcloak-sync.com) a read!

## License

This project is based on Mare Synchronos by DarkArchon. Original code is licensed under the MIT License; see the 
LICENSE_MIT file for details. Commits after 9e539810 are licenced under AGPL v3.

The Glamourer and Penumbra APIs remain MIT licensed, and are copyright Ottermandias.

variant.author: Eauldane
variant.changelog:
2.6.1
- Fixed regression with syncshell region detection.
- Removed our own changelog handler; we now use Dalamud's internal one.
2.6.0
- Updated to Dalamud API 15.
- Nameplates no longer colour with vanity colours, active pair colours, or Frostbrand availability during PvP.
- Sync data handoff has been reworked to be more reliable in very crowded areas.
- Lower-end systems can now request an alternative download compression format, with the server generating the needed variant automatically.
- Removed texture compression preferences; users now receive whichever version their pairs are wearing.
- Fixed an internal label leaking into a drawn label.
- Optimised internal dictionaries.
